info.title: Flixnet API
info.description: API of the Flixnet media server. Used by the web UI and future native apps.

ffmpeg_running.description: An ffmpeg process currently works for this session.

oneOf.description: What is playing (`None` if it vanished from the library meanwhile).

added.description: How many were new (already present ones are skipped).

auto_download.description: Download the local model automatically on first use.

has_openai_api_key.description: Whether an API key is stored (the key itself is never returned).

oneOf.description: Running or queued model download.

embedded.description: Titles with a vector of the current model.

oneOf.description: Running or queued embedding run.

missing.description: Files the local model still needs.

platform_supported.description: The local model can run on this platform.

seasons.description: Seasons whose analysis was queued (already pending ones are not counted).

albums.description: The artist's own albums, newest first.

appears_on.description: Other artists' albums (compilations) with tracks by this artist.

backdrop_url.description: Signed backdrop URL (fanart.tv or a local `fanart.jpg`), 1920 px wide.

popular.description: Most played tracks (all profiles of the household), then album order.

llm_enabled.description: An LLM endpoint is configured and switched on (chat, generated texts).

semantic.description: Local embeddings are available for semantic search.

max_channels.description: Most channels played without downmix (2 when omitted).

index.description: Stream index within the file (`audio_stream_index` in playback info).

position_ms.description: Listening position of the signed-in user (0 = not started or finished).

part.description: Index of the part (in `parts`) the chapter starts in.

parts.description: The audio files in playback order.

start_ms.description: Where the part starts in the book (ms).

url.description: Signed URL of the audio file (supports range requests).

position_ms.description: Where the book resumes now (0 = from the start).

has_config.description: A copy of the configuration file was saved next to it.

name.description: File name of the database snapshot.

restore_command.description: The command that restores a backup (with the server stopped).

score.description: 0–1: how well the candidate fits the item's title and year.

base_url.description:
Address a Chromecast reaches the server at (`null`: not configured, use the
browser's address).

oneOf.description: The guide channel this channel shows (`null`: no guide).

epg_disabled.description: An administrator decided this channel has no guide.

oneOf.description: What is on now and next.

start_ms.description: Start position in ms (scene hits), else from the resume point.

messages.description: The conversation so far, oldest first, ending with the user's message.

items.description: Titles the tools looked at (for cards under the answer).

item_count.description: Members the signed-in user may see.

kind.description:
`auto` (from TMDB), `manual` (curated by an administrator) or `theme`
(proposed by the LLM over the catalogue).

played_count.description: Of those, how many the user has watched.

poster_url.description: Signed poster URL (the collection's own, else a member's), 342 px wide.

tmdb_id.description: TMDB collection id of automatic collections.

url.description: XMLTV URL (http/https) or absolute file path; `.gz` files are unpacked.

max_age_rating.description: Age limit applied to the new account.

note.description: Free text, e.g. who the invitation is for.

valid_days.description: Days until the link expires (1–30, default 7).

intro_detection.description: Detect intros and credits of episodes (default: on).

paths.description: Absolute folder paths on the server.

oneOf.description: Makes it a smart playlist.

name.description: Shown in the group list (default: "Gruppe von <Name>").

tuner_count.description: Streams that may run at once; omit to use what the source reports.

url.description:
M3U: playlist URL or absolute file path; Xtream: server URL; HDHomeRun: IP
address or URL of the device.

user_agent.description: Sent when fetching the playlist and streams (some providers require one).

allow_unrated.description: With an age limit: show content without an age rating anyway.

blocked_genres.description: Genres to hide from the profile.

password.description: Omit for a profile that cannot sign in remotely (only reachable by switching).

code.description: The secret code; shown once. The web UI link is `/invite/{code}`.

bandwidth_total_bytes.description: All media traffic since the start.

cpu_percent.description: Whole machine (or container), percent of all cores.

DeviceInfo.description: The client installation that is signing in.

id.description: Stable id generated and stored by the client (e.g. a UUID).

DeviceProfile.description:
What a client can play directly. Web clients build it from `canPlayType` /
`MediaSource.isTypeSupported`; native apps send a fixed one.

containers.description: File containers the client plays as-is (file extensions: `mp4`, `webm`, `mkv`, …).

max_bitrate.description: Upper bound for the total bitrate (bits/s), e.g. for slow connections.

multiple_audio_tracks.description:
Whether the client can switch between audio tracks of one file. Browsers
cannot, so another track than the default one needs a remux.

path.description: The listed folder (`null` for the roots).

address.description: Ask one device directly (IP address or URL) instead of broadcasting.

configured.description: A tuner with this device id is already set up.

url.description: Address to add the device with.

DlnaStatus.description: Whether the DLNA server runs, and why not.

discovery.description: Discovery (SSDP multicast) works; without it clients need the address.

file_id.description: Version of the item (media file id); default: the first main file.

release.description: Release name from the search, kept for reference.

remaining_downloads.description: Downloads left today, if OpenSubtitles said.

saved_in_library.description:
`true`: saved next to the media file; `false`: in Flixnet's subtitle store
(the library folder is not writable).

stream_index.description: The new subtitle track (`subtitle_stream_index` in playback info).

rebuild.description: Recompute every vector instead of only new and changed titles.

decode_error.description: Why GPU decoding does not work.

device.description: Render node used (VA-API, Quick Sync on Linux).

error.description: Why encoding does not work (ffmpeg's last lines).

hw_decode.description: The GPU decodes HEVC Main 10 too.

tonemap.description: How HDR is tone-mapped with this method.

tonemap_error.description: Why GPU tone mapping does not work.

url.description: XMLTV URL or file path (gzip allowed).

ErrorBody.description: Error body returned by every failing API call.

based_on.description: Titles of the viewer's history the explanation is based on.

text.description: "Weil du „X“ und „Y“ gesehen hast …"; `null` without related history.

has_history.description: The profile has history or onboarding picks that shape the suggestions.

max_age_rating.description: Age limit applied for the group (the lowest of all members), if any.

exclude_watched.description: Leave out what any member has already watched or started (default: yes).

user_ids.description: Household profiles watching together (the signed-in profile always counts).

matches.description: Members this title suits especially well.

reason.description: e.g. „Passt zu allen“, „Passt besonders zu Anna“.

rows.description: One row per channel of this page, in guide order (same as `listChannels`).

server_url.description: Base URL of the other server, e.g. `http://192.168.1.10:32400`.

token.description: Plex: `X-Plex-Token`. Jellyfin: an API key (Dashboard → API-Schlüssel).

user_id.description:
Plex (one account per token) and Jellyfin sign-in: the Flixnet user to import
into.

user_map.description:
Jellyfin with API key: which Jellyfin user goes to which Flixnet user. Users
left out are mapped by equal name, if there is one.

username.description: Jellyfin without API key: sign in as this user (imports only that user).

applied.description: Whether anything was written (`false` for a preview).

unmatched_samples.description: Some titles that were not found in the library.

user_id.description: Flixnet user the history goes to (`None`: skipped, no mapping).

InterpretedQueryDto.description: The filter as understood, shown as chips above the results.

ItemCardDto.description: Enough to draw a poster card.

child_count.description: Seasons of a series / episodes of a season.

position_ms.description: Resume position in milliseconds (0 = from the start).

poster_url.description: Signed poster URL (episodes: still image), 342 px wide.

runtime_ms.description: Runtime from metadata, else the duration of the main file.

series_title.description: Title of the series (seasons and episodes).

job_id.description: Id of the queued job (`null` when the same job is already waiting).

offset.description: Offset of the first item with this letter in title order.

LibraryAccess.description: Which libraries a user may see.

artists.description: Music libraries: album artists, albums and tracks.

unprobed.description: Files whose technical details are still being read.

intro_detection.description: Whether intros and credits of episodes are detected ("Intro-Erkennung").

paths.description: Folder paths on the server (administrators only).

plan.description: Copy or transcode, with the reasons.

playlist_url.description: Live HLS playlist (the session id is the capability).

shared.description: Joined a stream someone else started (no extra tuner used).

viewers.description: User ids of the viewers (one entry per player).

has_api_key.description: Whether an API key is stored (it is never returned).

message.description: The model's answer, or what went wrong.

LogLevel.description: Severity, most severe first (so `level <= filter` keeps what a filter asks for).

seq.description: Increasing sequence number; pass the last one as `after` to tail the log.

last_seq.description: Newest sequence number; pass as `after` on the next poll.

time_ms.description: Start of the line in milliseconds (0 for plain lyrics).

source.description: `sidecar` (`.lrc` next to the file) or `embedded` (in the tags).

synced.description: Lines carry timestamps (LRC) and can follow playback.

entries.description: Entries with any state (watched, in progress, favorite, rated).

confidence.description: 0–1: share of compared episodes that agree (1 for manual segments).

start_ms.description: From the start of the file.

direct_url.description: Signed URL of the original file (supports HTTP range requests).

hls_url.description: HLS playlist of a transcode session, when the plan is not Direct Play.

plan.description: How this source would be played on the requesting device, and why.

segments.description: Intro, credits and recap of this file (for skip buttons), in playback order.

subtitle_tracks.description:
Subtitle tracks to choose from: text ones with a WebVTT URL, picture ones
burned in when chosen (`subtitle_stream_index`).

ready.description: Loaded and able to play at the group position.

has_fanart_api_key.description: Whether a fanart.tv API key is stored.

has_tmdb_api_key.description: Whether a TMDB API key is stored (the key itself is never returned).

musicbrainz_enabled.description: Music metadata and covers from MusicBrainz and the Cover Art Archive.

max_bitrate.description: Bitrate limit (bits/s); larger files are converted.

track_ids.description: Tracks to play (at most 1000), e.g. the current and the next queue entry.

oneOf.description: The filter the model chose (`llm` mode).

notice.description: Why the fallback was used, or what could not be applied.

dlna_user_id.description: User whose libraries and parental controls DLNA uses; `null` = DLNA off.

public_url.description:
Public or LAN address of the server (e.g. `http://192.168.1.10:8097`), used for
absolute URLs (Chromecast); `null` = the address the browser uses.

has_secret.description: Webhook: requests are signed (the secret itself is never returned).

has_token.description: ntfy: an access token is stored.

url.description: Webhook: the URL requests go to.

webhook_url.description: Discord: the webhook URL with its secret part masked.

NotificationTargetInput.description:
A notification target to create or replace. Secrets (`secret`, `token`,
`webhook_url`) that are omitted or `null` keep their stored value; an empty
string removes them.

oneOf.description: Required when creating; ignored on updates.

admin_group.description: Members of this group become administrators.

auto_create_users.description: Unknown accounts get a new Flixnet user.

has_client_secret.description: Whether a client secret is stored (it is never returned).

link_by_name.description:
Unknown accounts are linked to the Flixnet user whose name equals their
`preferred_username` (only enable if the provider controls these names).

redirect_uri.description:
Where the provider sends the browser back: the web UI's `/login/oidc` route
(must be registered at the provider).

items.description: Well-rated titles from across the library to pick from.

item_ids.description: Liked titles (movies or series), at most 50; an empty list clears the picks.

credits.description: Everything in the visible libraries this person worked on.

cover_url.description: Signed URL of the newest picture.

oneOf.description: Camera and exposure from EXIF (`null` without any).

large_url.description: Signed URL of the large view (1920 px wide).

oneOf.description: GPS position from EXIF.

original_url.description: Signed URL of the original file (clips play from it).

taken_at.description: When it was taken (unix ms; the file time without EXIF).

image_url.description: Signed URL of the chapter's image (JPEG), once made.

index.description: Chapter number within the file, from 0.

sources.description: Playable versions/parts of the item, main versions first.

audio_stream_index.description: Chosen audio stream (file stream index); default track when omitted.

device_profile.description: What the client can play directly; an empty profile means "transcode everything".

max_bitrate.description: Quality limit chosen by the user (bits/s).

subtitle_stream_index.description: Chosen subtitle stream (file stream index); none when omitted.

PlaybackReport.description: What a player reports (the same shape for start, progress and stop).

duration_ms.description: Total duration as the player sees it; the file's duration when omitted.

item_id.description: The movie or episode being played.

position_ms.description: Current position in milliseconds (multi-part movies: across all parts).

transcode_session_id.description: Transcode session from playback info, for Remux/Transcode.

id.description: Id for the following progress and stop reports.

played.description: The item now counts as watched.

resume_position_ms.description: Where the item resumes from now (0 = from the start).

is_owner.description: The signed-in user owns (and may edit) the playlist.

item_count.description: Items the signed-in user may see.

poster_urls.description: Up to four signed poster URLs of the first items (for a collage).

shared.description: Visible to every profile of the household (read-only for them).

oneOf.description: The filter of a smart playlist.

entry_id.description: Id of the entry (for removing and reordering); `null` in smart playlists.

item_ids.description: Movies and episodes; series and seasons are added as all their episodes.

entry_ids.description: Entry ids in the new order. Entries not listed keep their relative order after them.

skip_intro_automatically.description: Jump over intros (and recaps) without a click.

is_current.description: The profile currently signed in on this device.

episode_label.description: `S01E05` or as the guide writes it.

job_id.description: `null` when an equal job is already queued or running.

Reason.description: Why the file cannot simply be played as-is.

position_ms.description: The position the recap stops at (ms in the item).

source_item_id.description: For `because` rows: the title the row is based on.

title.description: Row title, e.g. „Weil du „Dark“ gesehen hast“.

available.description: Semantic data exists (AI enabled and the library embedded).

needs_onboarding.description: No history and no onboarding picks yet: show the onboarding.

because_item_id.description: The title the explanation refers to.

reason.description: Rule-based explanation, e.g. „Weil du „Alien“ gesehen hast“.

matched.description: Channels that have a guide now.

job_id.description: Job id, or `null` if a scan of this library is already pending.

play_url.description: Player link starting at the scene, e.g. `/play/12?start=93000`.

start_ms.description: Start of the matching dialogue window (ms).

transcribe.description: Whisper transcribes files without subtitles in this library.

terms.description: The words searched for (after dropping filler words).

task.description: Name of the task that (re)builds the index (`POST /tasks/{name}/run`).

whisper_path.description: Path of the whisper.cpp CLI (`whisper-cli`); `null` = Whisper off.

counted.description: The listen was long enough to count as a play.

listened_ms.description: How long the track was actually listened to (milliseconds, pauses excluded).

bytes.description: Bytes served for this session's stream so far.

bytes_per_second.description: Current rate (average over the last seconds).

SessionDto.description: A newly issued device token plus the signed-in user.

token.description: Send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Valid until logout or re-login on this device.

pin.description: 4–8 digits, or `null` to remove the PIN.

file_id.description: One file of the item; all its main files when omitted.

setup_required.description: `true` until the first administrator account has been created.

SmartFilterDto.description:
Saved filter of a smart playlist (the fields of `GET /items`). Empty lists and
missing values do not filter.

library_ids.description: Only these libraries (still limited to what the viewer may see).

played.description: Watched (`true`) or unwatched (`false`) by the viewer.

has_password.description: Whether a password is stored (it is never returned).

disk_total_bytes.description: The disk the folder is on (`None` if unknown).

used_bytes.description: Bytes used by the folder itself.

match_score.description: How well the release fits the file, 0–100 (100 = hash match).

moviehash_match.description: Made for exactly this file (same OpenSubtitles hash).

release.description: Release the subtitle was made for.

moviehash.description: OpenSubtitles hash of the file, if it could be read.

auto_download.description: Download subtitles for new movies and episodes automatically.

has_api_key.description: Whether an OpenSubtitles API key is stored (the key itself is never returned).

has_password.description: Whether a password for the account is stored.

burn_in.description: Picture subtitles: choosing them burns them into the video (a transcode).

codec.description: ffprobe codec name, or the file extension of a sidecar file.

index.description:
Stream index within the file; sidecar files are numbered from 1000
(`subtitle_stream_index` in playback info).

is_external.description: A sidecar file next to the media file.

is_sdh.description: For the deaf and hard of hearing.

vtt_url.description: Signed WebVTT URL for text subtitles, rendered by the player.

oneOf.description: `position_ms`: where the member paused (the group position when omitted).
The member's player is waiting for data.
The member's player can play at the group position.
Everybody switches to this item (e.g. the next episode).

While playing (about every second): the member's position at its estimate of
the server clock.
Clock sync; answered with `pong`.

SyncPlayClientMessage.description: What a member sends over the group WebSocket (JSON text frames).

members.description: Profile names of the connected members.

oneOf.description: First message after connecting: the member's id in this group.
Drift correction for this member: play at `rate`, or jump to `seek_to_ms`.
The group ended (or the member may no longer see its item).

SyncPlayServerMessage.description: What the server sends over the group WebSocket (JSON text frames).

SyncPlayStateDto.description: The shared playback as every member should show it.

position_ms.description:
Group position at server time `anchor_ms`; while playing it advances in real
time from there (`anchor_ms` may lie slightly in the future: start then).

revision.description: Increases with every change; older states are stale.

server_ms.description: Server time when this state was sent.

waiting.description: Waiting for members to load or buffer; paused until everybody is ready.

SystemInfo.description: Public server information used by clients to discover and identify the server.

api_version.description: API version that the routes are served under.

os.description: Operating system the server runs on.

error.description: Why it failed (German or the remote server's answer).

Tonemap.description: How HDR is tone-mapped to SDR.

artist.description: Track artist(s) as tagged, else the album artist.

cover_url.description: Signed album cover URL, 342 px wide.

play_count.description: Times the signed-in user listened to it.

container.description: Container (file extension) and codec of the original.

reasons.description: Why the file is converted (empty for Direct Play).

url.description: Signed URL to play (original file or AAC conversion).

has_client_secret.description: Whether the client secret is stored (it is never returned).

redirect_uri.description: Redirect URI to enter when creating the Trakt app.

configured.description: The administrator registered a Trakt app.

oneOf.description: A started connection that still waits for confirmation.

scrobble.description: Report playback to Trakt while watching.

pulled_watched.description: Watched items taken over from Trakt.

unmatched.description: Trakt entries without a match in the library.

transcoding.description: An ffmpeg process is currently running for this session.

TranscodingInfo.description: What transcodes run on, for the admin diagnostics.

detected.description: Detection has finished (until then transcodes use software).

fallbacks.description:
Hardware runs that failed and were retried with a simpler pipeline since the
server started.

hw_decode.description: The GPU decodes too (where it can decode the source).

probes.description: Every method that was tested, in test order.

tonemap.description: How HDR is tone-mapped to SDR.

TrickplayDto.description:
How the sheets are laid out: thumbnail `n = floor(position_ms / interval_ms)` is on
sheet `n / (columns × rows)`, row-major within it.

sheets.description: Signed URLs of the sheets (JPEG), in order.

thumbnails.description: Thumbnails in total (the last sheet may be partly filled).

tile_width.description: Size of one thumbnail in pixels.

has_password.description: Whether a password is stored (it is never returned).

tuner_count.description: Streams that may run at once (0 = unlimited).

tuner_count_manual.description: The count was set by an administrator (else it comes from the source).

url.description: Playlist URL/path, server URL or device address.

Unlock.description: What switching to a profile requires.

directory.description: Absolute folder; empty resets to the default.

enabled.description: Hidden channels appear neither in the channel list nor in the guide.

intro_detection.description: Switch intro/credits detection on or off.

fanart_api_key.description: fanart.tv personal API key; `null` removes it.

musicbrainz_enabled.description: Switch MusicBrainz / Cover Art Archive lookups for music on or off.

tmdb_api_key.description: TMDB v3 API key or v4 read access token; `null` removes it.

UpdateOidcSettings.description:
Provider settings. `client_secret` omitted or `null` keeps the stored one; `""`
removes it.

oneOf.description: New filter (smart playlists only).

transcribe_library_ids.description: Libraries to transcribe (replaces the current choice).

UpdateSmtpSettings.description: SMTP settings. `password` omitted or `null` keeps the stored one; `""` removes it.

api_key.description: OpenSubtitles.com API key (consumer key); `null` removes it.

UpdateTraktSettings.description:
The Trakt API app. `client_secret` omitted or `null` keeps the stored one; `""`
removes it.

password.description: A new password; `null` removes it, omitted keeps it.

tuner_count.description: `null` hands the tuner count back to the source.

UpdateUserRequest.description: Every field is optional; `null` clears nullable fields (password, PIN, age limit).

allow_unrated.description: With an age limit: show content without an age rating anyway.

blocked_genres.description: Genres to hide from the profile (replaces the list; `[]` clears it).

password.description: Setting or clearing the password signs the user out everywhere.

allow_unrated.description: With an age limit: content without an age rating is shown anyway.

has_password.description: Can sign in with a password (profiles without one are reachable by switching only).

has_pin.description: Profile switching to this user requires a PIN.

is_hidden.description: Hidden users do not appear in the profile picker.

source_user_id.description: User id on the other server.

user_id.description: Flixnet user that receives this history; `0` skips this user.

hdr.description: HDR formats shown as HDR (`hdr10`, `hlg`, `dovi`); others are tone-mapped.

codec.description: Output codec (the source codec when copied).

tonemap.description: HDR → SDR tone mapping during the transcode.

device_profile.description: What the client plays; copied streams need its support for the codecs.

api_key.name: api_key
api_key.description: Device token as query parameter, for URLs that cannot carry headers (media, images).
